description: This file declares the DobbyEventListener class and its nested OCIContainerNotification class, which implement event handling and notification mechanisms for container lifecycle events within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: Main class responsible for listening to container events and managing notification subscriptions within the plugin.

classes.name: OCIContainerNotification
classes.description: Nested class implementing the INotification interface to handle container lifecycle event callbacks.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the event listener with the service, event handler, and OCI container object.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the event listener, cleaning up resources.
